metadata.fiscalCycle: CY 2026 Adopted Municipal Budget & User-Friendly Budget
metadata.sourceAgency: NJ Department of Community Affairs (DLGS) & City of Clifton Finance Office

revenueSources.source: Local Property Tax for Municipal Purposes
revenueSources.description: Portion paid on quarterly municipal tax bills by property owners

revenueSources.source: State Aid (Energy Tax Receipts, Consolidated Municipal Property Tax Relief)
revenueSources.description: Direct state aid distributed by NJ Department of Community Affairs

revenueSources.source: Local Municipal Revenues (Court fees, building permits, licenses, parking)
revenueSources.description: Municipal court fines, construction code permits, health licenses, parking meters
Interest on late payments and tax sale lien redemptions
Audited prior-year unreserved municipal fund balance

majorAppropriations.details: Salaries for ~150+ sworn police officers (patrol, detective bureau, traffic division, juvenile bureau, community policing), 911 dispatchers, cruisers, fuel, body cameras, body armor, and ammunition.
Mandatory employer contributions to Police & Firemen's Retirement System (PFRS) and Public Employees' Retirement System (PERS) as billed by the State of New Jersey.
Salaries for professional firefighters, fire captains, lieutenants, and EMTs across 5 fire stations, apparatus maintenance, protective gear, ladder trucks, and ambulances.

majorAppropriations.category: Employee Group Health Insurance & Worker's Comp
majorAppropriations.details: Medical, dental, and prescription coverage for active municipal employees and eligible retirees, plus municipal risk insurance.
Salaries for DPW laborers, mechanics, drivers; street paving, road salting/snow plowing, weekly curbside recycling and trash collection, street sweeping, park maintenance, and sewer maintenance.
Principal redemption and interest payments on municipal capital improvement bonds, fire trucks, road reconstruction debt, and drainage projects.
City Manager's office, City Clerk (elections, records, OPRA), Tax Assessor, Tax Collector, Finance Director/CFO, Purchasing, and Information Technology.
Dedicated municipal library levy funding Clifton Main Memorial Library and Allwood Branch library staff, books, digital resources, and programs.
Municipal Attorney/legal defense counsel, Municipal Court judge, court administrator, prosecutor, public defender, and Uniform Construction Code (UCC) inspectors.

majorAppropriations.category: Health & Human Services, Senior Services & Recreation
majorAppropriations.details: City health officer, restaurant inspections, animal control, Clifton Senior Center, recreation league coordination, and community events.

majorAppropriations.category: Statutory Reserve for Uncollected Taxes (RUT — N.J.S.A. 40A:4-40)
majorAppropriations.details: Under NJ cash-basis budgeting law, Clifton City Hall must remit 100% of certified school ($161.8M) and county ($85.7M) tax levies regardless of local delinquency, requiring a mandatory ~$6.35M 'overlay' reserve built directly into municipal tax bills.

majorAppropriations.category: Dedicated Municipal Sewer Utility Enterprise & PVSC Treatment Fees (Separate Utility Bill)
majorAppropriations.details: Billed separately via tiered consumption statements tied to Passaic Valley Water Commission (PVWC) water meter readings. Funds Passaic Valley Sewerage Commission (PVSC) regional treatment charges and local sanitary sewer line maintenance.
